thread:
zoe: hey everyone — day 3 and i'm blocked on console access for both staging and prod. the onboarding form accepted but console shows me as "readonly" for staging and 403 for prod toggles. who can help get me the right groups and a short-lived sa key? :wave:

miguel: welcome zoe! :tada: fill the prod-jit form for prod access (https://redwood.internal/prod-jit) and the onboard form for staging. if you're readonly it usually means you're only in `console-readonly`. run `id` in your Okta profile to confirm groups.

zoe: i checked okta — groups show only `employees` and `engineering`. no console groups. i tried to request JIT but it says "no approvers configured for project".

anya: hi zoe — i can be the approver for the project temporarily. what's the project id and the flag id you need to toggle?

zoe: project `query-realtime`, flag `models.v3_canary`. i also need an sa to run a 30m smoke load against staging inference (3k requests). 6h TTL would be perfect.

people-ops-bot: Provisioning helper: adding zoe to console-operators and console-staging-users. Group changes may take up to 5 minutes to propagate. Ticket INC-52011 created.

miguel: i'll pre-stage the JIT so once groups land you can request activation. for the SA we create a vaulted secret at `secret/data/onboard/zoe/sa-smoke`. what roles do you need?

zoe: roles: `inference.invoker`, `logging.writer`. thanks!

infra-bot: JIT prepared: JIT-90412 awaiting activation for zoe. Target role: `ff-admin` (staging). Justification required on activation.

people-ops-bot: Group membership updated: zoe -> console-operators, console-staging-users.

zoe: groups landed. tried the JIT form and it now allows me to request. form asks for an approval note — what should i write?

anya: short note works best: "Temp ff-admin for models.v3_canary validation (ENG-15100). Duration 6h. Reviewer: anya."

zoe: requested JIT with that note. also submitted SA key request via the onboard form.

miguel: creating SA `sa-zoe-smoke` with TTL=6h and roles you requested. vault path: `secret/data/onboard/zoe/sa-smoke`. will post when vault is populated. command we use internally for reference:
```bash
# internal example
redwood-iam create-service-account --alias sa-zoe-smoke --roles inference.invoker,logging.writer --ttl 6h --vault-path secret/data/onboard/zoe/sa-smoke
```

infra-bot: JIT activated by anya for zoe. Window opens in 10 minutes for 6h. All toggle actions will be audited under AUDIT-89400.

miguel: vault secret created at secret/data/onboard/zoe/sa-smoke. apply `VAULT_TOKEN` or use the internal vault helper to fetch. remember to delete any local copies after your run.

zoe: got the key and the JIT window. flipping the flag now and running smoke. small question — who owns flag metadata so i can add description + runbook link?

anya: flag metadata lives in infra/feature-flags. open a tiny PR with: id, owner alias, short description, runbook link. tag `@platform-flag-owners`. if you want i can review.

zoe: will open the PR after the run. one follow-up: for prod access (we may need to reproduce) what extra steps are required? the prod-jit form asked for manager approval and 2FA.

anya: for prod we require manager approval (already configured), an explicit justification, and Okta MFA enrolled. people-ops also enforces membership in `sso-prod-access`. ping people-ops to add you once you're ready and include the ticket id and manager alias.

people-ops-bot: Note: for PROD JIT please confirm your Okta MFA is set up. Manual add to `sso-prod-access` available on request.

zoe: tests passed in staging. i'll open PR to infra/feature-flags and then request prod JIT if we need to reproduce. thanks for the quick help everyone! :rocket:
